# Tsakani Sessions

> Cape Town-based DJ entertainment and live-music event brand offering DJ performances, full event experiences, and content creation across Cape Town and the Western Cape, South Africa. Tagline: "Two Tales of Happiness, Friendship & Brotherhood."

Tsakani Sessions is a cultural movement — community-first, authentic, themed around happiness, friendship and brotherhood. Bookings, event tickets and merch checkout all happen over WhatsApp.

## Contact
- Website: https://tsakanisessions.co.za
- WhatsApp / Phone: +27 76 996 1477 (https://wa.me/27769961477)
- Email: tsakanisessions@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/tsakani_sessions

## Services
- Full Tsakani Experience — live DJs, rising local talent, content creation, interactive vibe zones, full production & equipment.
- DJ & Live Performance — curated local and emerging DJs and acts.
- Content & Documentation — event videography, photography and social-media content with post-production.

Cape Town and the Western Cape, South Africa (locale en-ZA).

## How to book
Choose a service on the website and submit the booking form, or message +27 76 996 1477 on WhatsApp. Event tickets (Early Bird / General / VIP) and merch (R450 tees) check out via WhatsApp.
